name: Dining Hall of Misaligned Metaphors
description: A grand hall where metaphors go to get confused.
environment_gags: Tables that rearrange themselves when you blink.

jokes.setup: The soup tastes like existential dread.

jokes.punchline: Ontology Knight insists it is 'ontologically crisp'.

jokes.setup: This meal is to die for.
jokes.punchline: Ontology Knight: 'The meal is to live for. The dying is your own arrangement.'
Camus bots: 'Absurd. Delightful. Somebody please check the chandelier wiring.'

interactions: Click the chandelier to hear Lightbringer explain cosmic lighting.
Tap the table to trigger a metaphor realignment.
